dosha_involved: Pitta-Vata aggravation, Ama (toxin) obstruction in Rasa Dhatu
common_symptoms: Bitter or dry taste in mouth
step_by_step_remedy: Step 1 - Langhana (Digestive Rest): Avoid heavy meals immediately. Allow the digestive fire (Agni) to burn accumulated toxins (Ama). Drink warm boiled water (Ushnodaka) at regular intervals.

Step 2 - Giloy & Tulsi Decoction (Amrita Kwatha): Take 1 teaspoon of Giloy (Guduchi) powder or 4-inch fresh stem and 7-8 fresh Tulsi (Holy Basil) leaves. Boil in 2 cups (400ml) of water until reduced to half (200ml). Strain, add a pinch of black pepper (Maricha), and drink warm twice daily.

Step 3 - Ginger & Coriander Water (Dhanyaka-Shunti Toya): Boil 1 teaspoon crushed coriander seeds and half teaspoon dry ginger in 1 liter of water. Sip throughout the day to reduce feverish heat and thirst.
Step 4 - Cold Compress (Sheetal Upachara): If temperature exceeds 101°F (38.3°C), apply cool (not ice-cold) damp cotton cloth forehead compresses soaked in rose water or plain cool water.
pathya_diet_recommended: Peya and Manda (Light rice gruel / kanji)
Moong dal soup tempered with mild cumin and ginger
Warm water boiled with Tulsi
Pomegranate (Dadima) juice diluted
apathya_diet_avoid: Heavy, oily, or fried foods
Milk, cheese, yogurt (curd)
Cold water, iced beverages, ice creams
Raw salads and hard-to-digest meats
lifestyle_and_yoga: Complete bed rest; avoid physical exertion and direct draft of cold air or AC fan.
Gentle Shavasana (Corpse pose) for mental relaxation.
Avoid sleeping during daytime.
emergency_escalation_triggers: Temperature rises above 103°F (39.4°C) or does not reduce within 48 hours.
Severe stiff neck, mental confusion, delirium, or seizures.
Difficulty breathing or chest pain.
Severe vomiting, inability to keep fluids down, or blood in stool/vomit.

dosha_involved: Kapha-Vata imbalance affecting Pranavaha Srotas (respiratory channels)
step_by_step_remedy: Step 1 - Golden Turmeric Milk (Haridra Dugdha): Warm 1 cup of cow's milk (or almond milk) with 1/2 teaspoon pure turmeric powder, 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, and 1/2 teaspoon pure desi cow ghee. Drink before bed to soothe throat mucosal lining.
Step 2 - Sitopaladi & Licorice Honey Paste: Mix 1/2 teaspoon Sitopaladi Churna and 1/4 teaspoon Yashtimadhu (Licorice/Mulethi) powder with 1 teaspoon raw honey. Lick slowly 3 times a day.

Step 3 - Steam Inhalation with Ajwain/Camphor (Bashpa Sweda): Add 1 teaspoon Carom seeds (Ajwain) or 2 drops eucalyptus oil to boiling water. Inhale steam covered with a towel for 8-10 minutes to open congested sinuses.
Step 4 - Warm Saline-Turmeric Gargle (Kavala): Gargle with warm water containing rock salt (Saindhava) and a pinch of turmeric 3 times daily.
pathya_diet_recommended: Warm soups with black pepper and garlic
Warm water boiled with ginger
Steamed seasonal vegetables
Honey with crushed fresh ginger juice
apathya_diet_avoid: Chilled drinks, refrigerated water, ice cream
Yogurt (curd), banana, heavy dairy at night
Deep-fried oily snacks
Cold wind exposure
lifestyle_and_yoga: Anulom Vilom (Alternate nostril breathing) for 10 minutes.
Keep throat and chest covered with warm cotton or woolen clothing.
Nasya with 2 drops of warm sesame oil or Anu Taila in each nostril.
emergency_escalation_triggers: Difficulty breathing, wheezing, or stridor.
Coughing up blood or rust-colored sputum.
High fever lasting over 3 days.
Cyanosis (bluish lips or fingernails).

dosha_involved: Pitta aggravation with impaired Jatharagni (Digestive Fire) and Samana Vata
common_symptoms: Burning sensation in chest and throat (Heartburn)
Loss of hunger or irregular appetite
step_by_step_remedy: Step 1 - Cumin, Coriander & Fennel Infusion (CCF Tea): Boil 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds (Jeera), 1/2 teaspoon coriander seeds (Dhaniya), and 1/2 teaspoon fennel seeds (Saunf) in 500ml water for 5 minutes. Strain and sip warm after meals.
Step 2 - Fresh Ginger Slice with Rock Salt: Chew a thin slice of fresh ginger sprinkled with a pinch of rock salt (Saindhava Lavana) and 2 drops of lemon juice 15 minutes before lunch to ignite Agni.
Step 3 - Hingwastak Powder with Ghee: For severe gas and bloating, take 1/2 teaspoon Hingwastak Churna mixed with the first morsel of warm rice and 1/2 teaspoon melted ghee.
Step 4 - Cold Milk / Coconut Water for Acute Heartburn: Sip 1/2 cup cool organic milk or tender coconut water to extinguish burning Pitta.
pathya_diet_recommended: Old rice, barley, moong dal khichdi
Tender coconut water, sweet pomegranate
Amla (Indian gooseberry) juice or preserve (Murabba)
Freshly prepared thin buttermilk (Takra) with roasted cumin
apathya_diet_avoid: Spicy, sour, fermented foods (vinegar, excess pickles, chillies)
Caffeine, black tea, alcohol, carbonated sodas
Late-night heavy dinners and lying down immediately after meals
lifestyle_and_yoga: Vajrasana (Thunderbolt pose) for 10-15 minutes immediately after eating.
Eat in a calm, quiet atmosphere without mobile screens.
Allow at least 3 hours between dinner and sleep.
emergency_escalation_triggers: Crushing chest pain radiating to left arm or jaw (potential cardiac emergency).
Vomiting coffee-ground material or bright blood.
Severe unyielding abdominal pain or rigid abdomen.

dosha_involved: Vata vitiation settling in Asthi (bones) and Sandhi (joints), depletion of Shleshaka Kapha
common_symptoms: Pain and cracking sound (Crepitus) in knee/wrist/finger joints
Worsening pain during cold and damp weather
step_by_step_remedy: Step 1 - Warm Sesame & Nirgundi Oil Application (Abhyanga): Warm 2-3 tablespoons of Mahanarayan Taila or Nirgundi oil. Gently massage the affected joint in clockwise circular motions for 10 minutes.
Step 2 - Warm Herbal Compress (Nadi Sweda / Potali): Apply a hot water bag or a warm compress made of carom seeds (Ajwain) tied in a cotton pouch heated on a dry skillet over the massaged joint.

Step 3 - Turmeric, Fenugreek & Ginger Tonic: Mix 1/2 tsp roasted Fenugreek (Methi) seed powder, 1/2 tsp dry ginger (Shunti), and 1/2 tsp turmeric powder in warm water. Drink once every morning on an empty stomach.
Step 4 - Castor Oil Detox (Eranda Taila): Take 1 teaspoon food-grade Castor oil in warm ginger tea once a week at bedtime to purge colon Vata and soothe joints.
pathya_diet_recommended: Warm, freshly cooked moist foods with pure cow ghee
Warm vegetable soups with garlic and cumin
Sesame seeds (Til) soaked overnight
Walnuts and almonds soaked in water
apathya_diet_avoid: Cold, dry, stale, and refrigerated foods
Bitter gourd, excess raw salads, gram flour (besan)
Exposure to freezing AC drafts without warm clothing
lifestyle_and_yoga: Gentle joint mobilization (Sukshma Vyayama) without strain.
Sunbath (Surya Sevana) for 15-20 minutes in early morning sunshine.
Avoid standing or walking continuously on hard surfaces.
emergency_escalation_triggers: Sudden inability to bear weight on the joint with intense redness and heat.
Joint deformity following sudden trauma or fall.
High fever accompanying hot, swollen joint (possible septic arthritis).

dosha_involved: Prana Vata and Sadhaka Pitta disturbance causing hyperactivity of Manas (Mind)
common_symptoms: Difficulty falling asleep or waking up repeatedly
Restless thoughts, mental overwhelm, and palpitations
Morning fatigue, low mood, and irritability
step_by_step_remedy: Step 1 - Ashwagandha & Nutmeg Night Elixir: Mix 1/2 teaspoon organic Ashwagandha powder and a pinch (1/8 tsp) of freshly grated Nutmeg (Jaiphal) into 1 cup of warm cow's milk with 1/2 tsp ghee. Drink 30 minutes before sleep.
Step 2 - Foot Massage (Pada Abhyanga): Massage the soles of your feet with warm sesame oil, ghee, or Brahmi oil for 5 minutes before bed. This calms Prana Vata and promotes deep sleep.
Step 3 - Brahmi / Shankhpushpi Herbal Tea: Steep 1 teaspoon Brahmi leaves or Shankhpushpi powder in boiling water for 7 minutes. Sip in early evening to reduce cortisol and quiet mental agitation.
Step 4 - Nasya with Pure Ghee: Instill 2 drops of lukewarm cow ghee into each nostril before sleep.
pathya_diet_recommended: Sweet, unctuous, grounding foods
Warm milk, dates, soaked raisins and figs
Basmati rice with ghee, sweet juicy fruits
apathya_diet_avoid: Caffeine, coffee, energy drinks, nicotine (especially after 2 PM)
Excessive blue light exposure from phones/laptops within 1 hour of sleep
Pungent, dry, and stimulating fast foods
lifestyle_and_yoga: Bhramari Pranayama (Humming Bee breath) 7-10 rounds before sleep.
Yoga Nidra guided relaxation.
Establish a regular sleep schedule: in bed by 10:00 PM.
emergency_escalation_triggers: Severe acute panic attack with shortness of breath and chest tightness.
Thoughts of self-harm or acute psychological crisis.
Disorientation or acute memory loss.

condition_name: Skin Rashes, Itching & Allergies (Twak Roga & Kandu)
dosha_involved: Pitta and Rakta (blood) toxicity with Kapha stagnation
common_symptoms: Red itchy patches or hives (Urticaria / Shitapitta)
Sensitivity to heat and certain foods
step_by_step_remedy: Step 1 - Fresh Neem & Turmeric Cleanser: Boil a handful of fresh Neem leaves in 1 liter of water until the water turns green. Let it cool to lukewarm and use it to wash the affected skin area.

Step 2 - Pure Aloe Vera & Coconut Soothing Gel: Mix 2 tablespoons fresh pure Aloe Vera pulp with 1 teaspoon virgin cold-pressed coconut oil. Gently dab over the rash 3 times daily to extinguish heat and soothe itching.
Step 3 - Manjistha & Neem Blood Purifying Tonic: Take 1/2 teaspoon Manjistha powder and 1/4 teaspoon Neem powder with warm water twice a day after meals to cleanse Rakta Dhatu.

Step 4 - Coriander & Cumin Cooling Drink: Soak 1 teaspoon crushed coriander seeds in 1 glass of water overnight. Strain, add 1/2 teaspoon rock sugar (Mishri), and drink in the morning on an empty stomach.
pathya_diet_recommended: Bitter and astringent cooling foods: bitter gourd (Karela), cucumber, bottle gourd (Lauki)
Moong dal, pomegranate, sweet apples
Lots of fresh lukewarm water and coconut water
apathya_diet_avoid: Fermented foods, curd (yogurt), cheese, pickles, vinegar
Seafood, red meat, excessive garlic, green chillies
Synthetic soaps, rough synthetic clothes, scratching with fingernails
lifestyle_and_yoga: Sheetali and Sheetkari cooling Pranayama for 10 minutes.
Wear loose, breathable pure cotton garments.
Avoid direct midday sun exposure.
emergency_escalation_triggers: Rapidly spreading hives accompanied by swelling of lips, tongue, or throat (Anaphylaxis).
Difficulty breathing or swallowing.
Blistering skin lesions with high fever or pus discharge.

dosha_involved: Vata-Pitta vitiation in Uttamanga (Head) with constriction of cranial channels
common_symptoms: Sensitivity to bright light (Photophobia) and loud sounds
Nausea or visual aura before headache onset
step_by_step_remedy: Step 1 - Sandalwood or Ginger Temple Paste: For Pitta/throbbing heat headache, apply pure Sandalwood (Chandan) paste mixed with rose water on temples and forehead. For Vata/cold tension headache, apply a warm mild ginger powder paste.
Step 2 - Nasya Therapy (Nasal Drops): Lie back and instill 2 drops of lukewarm Cow's Ghee or Shadbindu Taila into each nostril. Inhale gently and rest for 10 minutes.
Step 3 - Brahmi & Chamomile Calming Infusion: Steep 1/2 teaspoon Brahmi and 1/2 teaspoon dry ginger in warm water with a teaspoon of rock sugar. Drink in a quiet, dark room.
Step 4 - Acupressure / Marma Therapy: Gently press the Sthapani Marma (the point between the eyebrows) and Adhipati Marma (crown of the head) with circular thumb pressure for 2 minutes.
pathya_diet_recommended: Warm cow's milk with cardamom and dates
Fresh coconut water, sweet grapes, soaked raisins
Warm vegetable soups seasoned with cumin
apathya_diet_avoid: Aged cheeses, chocolate, processed monosodium glutamate (MSG)
Skipping meals or erratic eating times (fasting triggers Pitta headache)
Straining eyes on small screens in dark rooms
lifestyle_and_yoga: Rest in a quiet, dimly lit, well-ventilated room.
Gentle neck stretching and shoulder rolls.
Nadi Shodhana Pranayama for balanced neurological flow.
emergency_escalation_triggers: Sudden catastrophic 'thunderclap' headache with maximum intensity in seconds.
Headache associated with fever, neck stiffness, and confusion (Meningitis sign).
Headache accompanied by numbness, slurred speech, or weakness on one side of body (Stroke warning).

dosha_involved: Kapha-Vata dominance with Medovaha Srotas (fat tissue) imbalance
common_symptoms: Slow wound healing and tingling in hands/feet
step_by_step_remedy: Step 1 - Fenugreek Seed Infusion: Soak 1 tablespoon Fenugreek (Methi) seeds in 1 glass of water overnight. In the morning, drink the water and chew the soft seeds thoroughly.

Step 2 - Jamun Seed & Bitter Gourd Powder: Mix equal parts of Jamun seed powder, Karela (Bitter Gourd) powder, and Gurmar (Gymnema sylvestre) powder. Take 1 teaspoon with warm water 30 minutes before lunch and dinner.
Step 3 - Vijaysar Water (Pterocarpus marsupium): Soak a piece of Vijaysar wood in water overnight in an earthen pot. Drink the herbalized red water on an empty stomach.
Step 4 - Amla & Turmeric Tonic (Nisha-Amalaki): Mix 1 teaspoon fresh Amla juice (or powder) with 1/2 teaspoon pure turmeric powder. Take every morning to protect microvascular channels.
pathya_diet_recommended: Barley (Yava), millets (Ragi, Jowar), brown rice in small portions
Bitter vegetables: Karela, Methi leaves, pointed gourd (Parwal)
Moong dal, horse gram (Kulthi), roasted chana
Cinnamon water and green tea
apathya_diet_avoid: Refined white sugar, sweets, sugarcane juice, jaggery in excess
Refined flours (Maida), white bread, fried potatoes
Sedentary sleeping during daytime (Divasvapna)
lifestyle_and_yoga: Daily brisk walking for 45 minutes in fresh morning air.
Surya Namaskar (Sun Salutations), Mandukasana (Frog pose), and Ardha Matsyendrasana.
Kapalabhati Pranayama (15 minutes daily under guidance).
emergency_escalation_triggers: Blood sugar spikes > 300 mg/dL or drops < 70 mg/dL (hypoglycemia with cold sweat, tremors, confusion).
Fruity breath odor with rapid deep breathing (Diabetic Ketoacidosis).
Non-healing ulcers with blackish skin discoloration on feet.
